intent: Use action contrast to distinguish stop to do / stop doing, then construct plans, requests, negative requests, purpose, too-to and prospective remember expressions.
picturePurpose: Tap contrasting original later-action panels. The separate written record establishes the earlier action, so a still image is never treated as proof of time or intent. Existing original science-room art locates a stated wish.

transfer.stem:
教练提醒大家不要在走廊跑。我们慢慢走，是为了确保每个人安全。两空依次填什么？
The coach reminded us ___ in the corridor. We walked slowly ___ everyone safe.

explanation.strategy: 先找提醒的对象，再区分“不去做”的内容和行动的目的。

steps.text: 教练提醒我们不要跑：remind somebody not to do。
steps.reason: us 是被提醒的人，后接 not to run。

steps.text: 慢走的目的是让每个人安全。
steps.reason: 用不定式 to keep 表达 walked slowly 的目的。

distractors.reason: remind us 后表达提醒我们不要做，用 not to run，不用 not running。
这里表达慢走的目的，用 to keep，不是 keeping。

explanation.pitfall: 否定的提醒与肯定的目的分别判断，不把所有动词都改成同一种形式。

visual.title: 提醒内容 / 行动目的

segments.text: walked slowly → to keep everyone safe

visual.caption: 第一空接在 us 后说明提醒内容，第二空说明慢走的目的。
